title: Small fillings of sphere slices at low-density points from the in-range isoperimetric filling, d + 1 < P (parent steps 2–4)
statement: Assume (SL), (MR) and (Isor), which appear verbatim as the three hypotheses of the Lean statement. (SL) is the exact frozen type of the accepted cmc_slice_mass_bounds: for an open U ⊆ ℝ^P, T ∈ 𝒟_{k+1}(U) represented by (μ, ξ) together with ∂T represented by (μ', ξ') (measures finite on compact subsets of U, a.e. strongly measurable fields with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| a.e.) and an L-Lipschitz f, there are A_t, B_t with A_t(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ, B_t(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ', ∂A_t(η) = B_t(η) whenever tsupport η misses {f = t}, M_W(∂A_t − B_t) ≤ L·liminf_{h↓0} h⁻¹μ(W ∩ {t − h < f < t}) for open W, and the integrated bound. (MR) is the exact frozen type of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: M_W(T) = R.measure(W) for every IMRep R of T ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U and W open. (Isor) is the in-range isoperimetric filling, verbatim the third hypothesis of the selected parent: for all P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P there is a real c ≥ 1 such that every integer multiplicity Z ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, ∂Z = 0 and M(Z) < ∞ equals ∂Y for an integer multiplicity Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with M(Y) ≤ c(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}M(Z) and spt Y ⊆ thickening(3√P(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}, spt Z) (M(Z) read as a real number). Then for all P, d ∈ ℕ with d + 1 < P there is η₀ > 0 with the following property. Let C ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with ∂C = 0, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K, ξ a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field of (d+1)-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| for μ-a.e. x and all α and C(ω) = ∫ξ(ω)dμ for every test form ω, and suppose C has the integer slice property ISP (verbatim the ISP hypothesis of the selected parent: for all admissible representations (μ₁, ξ₁) of C and (μ₁', ξ₁') of ∂C and every Lipschitz f, for L¹-a.e. t, all currents A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P), B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ₁(ω)dμ₁ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ₁'(η)dμ₁' have ∂A − B integer multiplicity). If x₁ ∈ ℝ^P satisfies liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x₁))/(ω_{d+1}r^{d+1}) < η₀ (ω_{d+1} = unitBallVolume (d+1), quotient in [0, ∞], liminf along 𝓝[>] 0), then for every δ > 0 there are ρ ∈ (0, δ) with μ(∂B_ρ(x₁)) = 0 and currents A, S ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{B_ρ(x₁)} ξ(ω)dμ for every test form ω, ∂S = ∂A, M(S) ≤ ½·μ(B_ρ(x₁)) and spt S ⊆ B̄_{(1+3√P)δ}(x₁).
